documentation.content: Verify the actor and approved change record. Follow docs/security/incident-response.md for an unexpected IAM, service-account, function, or secret change.

conditions.displayName: IAM, function, or secret control changed

conditionMatchedLog.filter: logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com" AND (protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.methodName:"UpdateFunction" OR protoPayload.methodName:"CreateFunction" OR protoPayload.methodName:"DeleteFunction" OR protoPayload.methodName:"AddSecretVersion" OR protoPayload.methodName:"DestroySecretVersion")
